questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Cheetahs are one of the world's most-recognisable cats, known especially for their speed.

B. Their faces too are distinguished by prominent black lines that curve from the inner corner of each eye to the outer corners of the mouth, like a well-worn trail of inky tears.

C. Cheetahs are covered almost entirely with small black spots on a background of pale yellow and have a white underbelly.

D. They have a long, slender body measuring 1.2 metres (4 feet), with a long tail (65-85 cm [2-3 feet]) that generally ends in a white tuft.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'ABDC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• Here, **'Sentence A'** should be the first sentence because the given paragraph is talking about the Cheetas. And **Sentence A **is an introductory sentence.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the next sentence. (Moreover, only **option 1** starts with **'A',** therefore we can instantly mark it as the correct answer)
 
• **Sentence B** is talking about the physical appearance of '**Cheetahs**' and** Sentence D** is also talking about the physical appearance. Hence, both of these sentences are connected.
 
• **Hence, sentence D** will be the next sentence.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence C** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **A**: Cheetahs are one of the world's most-recognisable cats, known especially for their speed.
 
• **B**: Their faces too are distinguished by prominent black lines that curve from the inner corner of each eye to the outer corners of the mouth, like a well-worn trail of inky tears.
 
• **D**: They have a long, slender body measuring 1.2 metres (4 feet), with a long tail (65-85 cm [2-3 feet]) that generally ends in a white tuft.
 
• **C**: Cheetahs are covered almost entirely with small black spots on a background of pale yellow and have a white underbelly.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Cheetahs are one of the world's most-recognisable cats, known especially for their speed. Their faces too are distinguished by prominent black lines that curve from the inner corner of each eye to the outer corners of the mouth, like a well-worn trail of inky tears. They have a long, slender body measuring 1.2 metres (4 feet), with a long tail (65-85 cm [2-3 feet]) that generally ends in a white tuft. Cheetahs are covered almost entirely with small black spots on a background of pale yellow and have a white underbelly.*

• **Hold up** is a **phrasal verb** meaning **support and prevent something from falling.**
 
 
• For Example - Concrete pillars **hold up** the elevated section of the railway.
 
 
 
• The use of 'Being' is wrong because it is used in the present or past continuous tense.
 
• **'Being'** is used in the passive sense and it is wrong in the context of the given sentence.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The roof **is held up by **two stone pillars.*

• **By **का उपयोग उस व्यक्ति या चीज़ को दिखाने के लिए किया जाता है जो कुछ करता है।

• '**Being**' का प्रयोग गलत है क्योंकि इसका प्रयोग **present or past continuous tense** में होता है।
 
• '**Being**' का प्रयोग **passive sense** में किया गया है और यह दिए गए वाक्य के संदर्भ में गलत है।

questions.question: As observed from the top of a lighthouse, 42 m high above sea-level, the angle of depression of a ship sailing directly towards it changes from 30° to 45°. The distance travelled by the ship during the period of observation is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the angle of elevation (or depression) of a tower of height h changes from θ₁ to θ₂ as an object moves directly towards it, the distance travelled is:

Distance = h × (cot θ₁ − cot θ₂)

Here, h = 42 m, θ₁ = 30°, θ₂ = 45°

Distance = 42 × (cot 30° − cot 45°)

Distance = 42 × (√3 − 1)

**∴ The correct answer is 42(√3 − 1) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Height of the lighthouse (AB) = 42 m

Angle of depression at initial position C = 30° ⇒ Angle of elevation ∠ACB = 30°

Angle of depression at final position D = 45° ⇒ Angle of elevation ∠ADB = 45°

**Formula Used:**

In a right-angled triangle, tan θ = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

In right-angled triangle ΔABD,

⇒ tan 45° = AB ÷ BD

⇒ 1 = 42 ÷ BD

⇒ BD = 42 m

In right-angled triangle ΔABC,

⇒ tan 30° = AB ÷ BC

⇒ 1 ÷ √3 = 42 ÷ BC

⇒ BC = 42√3 m

The distance travelled by the ship is CD, which is the difference between BC and BD.

⇒ Distance CD = BC − BD

⇒ Distance CD = 42√3 − 42

⇒ Distance CD = 42(√3 − 1) m

**∴ The correct answer is 42(√3 − 1) m.**

Heights and Distances (Trigonometry)

The angle of elevation is the angle formed between the horizontal reference line and the line of sight when looking up at an object. The angle of depression is the angle formed when looking down from a height.

Two Objects on the Same Side

If two objects are observed on the ground from a tower of height h at angles θ₁ and θ₂, the distance separating them is easily calculated as h(cot θ₁ − cot θ₂).

questions.question: Which of the following is used as a primary means of implementing the monetary policy of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Repo rate.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Repo stands for Repurchase Rate.
 
• Repo rate is the rate at which the central bank of a country lends money to commercial banks in the event of any shortfall of funds.
 
• In the event of inflation, central banks increase the repo rate as this acts as a disincentive for banks to borrow from it. This ultimately reduces the money supply within the economy and thus helps in arresting inflation.
 
• **Repo Rate is the most vital rate for the common man.**
 
• Everything from interest rates on loans to returns on deposits is influenced by this important rate set by the RBI, which is why interest rates on home loans, car loans and other forms of borrowings go up and down supporting the direction of Repo Rate change.
 
• Similarly, banks adjust bank accounts, fixed deposit returns supported this benchmark.
 
• **Hence Repo rate is used as a primary means of implementing the monetary policy of the Reserve Bank of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monetary policy** refers to the policy of the central bank with regard to the use of monetary instruments under its control to achieve the goals specified in the Act.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is vested with the responsibility of conducting monetary policy. This responsibility is explicitly mandated under the** Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.**
 
• The primary objective of monetary policy is to maintain price stability while keeping in mind the objective of growth.
 
• Price stability is a necessary precondition to sustainable growth.

questions.question: Shigmotsav is essentially a festival of the masses, celebrated on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna (March). Which state celebrates this festival?

• Shigmo is celebrated all over India but in different names:
 
 
• North India - Holi.
 
• Assam and Bengal - Dolyatra.
 
• South India - Kamadahan.
 
• Maharashtra - Shimga.
